turns.q: And if I change my mind, how easy is it to return?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Returns are easy with Faherty: - You can return or exchange eligible items within 60 days of purchase, as long as they’re unworn, unwashed, and have original tags. - Returns can be started online through the [Returns Center](https://fahertybrand.loopreturns.com/#/) or at any Faherty store. - You can use a Return Bar for quick, box-free returns and get your refund right away, or mail your item back (a $7 fee applies for mail-in returns).
